basis: Scope map 3.1 Must explain; SEP-GEN-01 and 03.

slots.question: Which hosts make up the system, what role does each play, where are they, and what platform and operating system does each run on?
Which systems outside the OT zones does the system depend on or exchange data with, by which mechanism?
Which non-Windows layers does the system rely on (radios, base stations, gateways, appliances, licence dongles)?
Is an inventory of these assets and dependencies maintained, and by whom?
